AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 双随机矩阵, 过平滑, 残差质量补偿, 结构编码
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的图矩阵构建方式，通过双随机矩阵（DSM）替代传统的拉普拉斯矩阵，有效地解决了GNN中常见的过平滑问题。其核心创新在于残差质量补偿机制，既保证了计算效率，又在理论上严谨地恢复了随机性，具有很高的学术价值和应用潜力。

title: Emulation-based System-on-Chip Security Verification: Challenges and Opportunities
summary:
Increasing system-on-chip (SoC) heterogeneity, deep hardware/software integration, and the proliferation of third-party intellectual property (IP) have brought security validation to the forefront of semiconductor design. While simulation and formal verification remain indispensable, they often struggle to expose vulnerabilities that emerge only under realistic execution conditions, long software-driven interactions, and adversarial stimuli. In this context, hardware emulation is emerging as an increasingly important pre-silicon verification technology because it enables higher-throughput execution of RTL designs under realistic hardware/software workloads while preserving sufficient fidelity for security-oriented analysis.
  This paper presents a comprehensive survey and perspective on emulation-based security verification and validation. We organize the landscape of prior work across assertion-based security checking, coverage-driven exploration, adversarial testing, information-flow tracking, fault injection, and side-channel-oriented evaluation. We provide a structured view of emulation-enabled security verification workflows, including instrumentation, stimulus generation, runtime monitoring, and evidence-driven analysis. We also examine practical challenges related to observability, scalability, property specification, and the definition of security-oriented coverage metrics for emulation-based verification. Finally, we discuss emerging directions such as AI-assisted emulation, digital security twins, chiplet-scale security exploration, automated vulnerability assessment, and cloud-scale secure emulation. Overall, this paper positions emulation as a promising foundation for the next generation of pre-silicon hardware security assurance.

AI.title_translation: 基于仿真的片上系统安全验证：挑战与机遇
AI.tldr: 本文综述了利用硬件仿真技术进行SoC安全验证的现状，分析了其在应对复杂安全威胁中的优势、现有技术工作流、面临的挑战及未来演进方向。
AI.motivation: 随着SoC异构性增加、软硬件集成加深以及第三方IP的使用，传统的仿真和形式化验证方法难以覆盖复杂的真实运行环境及对抗性场景，因此迫切需要一种能兼顾高性能与高安全保真度的验证技术。
AI.method: 通过全面调研，将仿真安全验证工作分类为断言检查、覆盖率驱动探索、对抗测试、信息流跟踪、故障注入及侧信道评估；并构建了包含仪器化、激励生成、运行时监控及证据驱动分析的标准化工作流。
AI.result: 确立了硬件仿真在SoC安全验证中的地位，系统总结了现有技术框架，识别了观测性、可扩展性及安全覆盖度量等关键挑战，并展望了AI辅助仿真、数字孪生等新兴发展趋势。
AI.conclusion: 硬件仿真技术凭借其高吞吐量和高保真度，已成为解决复杂SoC安全验证问题的核心支柱，未来将向自动化、智能化及大规模云端部署方向演进。
AI.translation: 日益增加的片上系统（SoC）异构性、深度的软硬件集成以及第三方知识产权（IP）的激增，使得安全验证成为半导体设计的重中之重。虽然仿真和形式化验证仍然必不可少，但它们往往难以暴露仅在真实执行条件、长软件驱动交互和对抗性刺激下才会出现的漏洞。在此背景下，硬件仿真作为一种重要的前硅片验证技术正日益凸显，因为它能够在保持足够安全分析保真度的同时，实现RTL设计在真实软硬件负载下的高吞吐量执行。本文对基于仿真的安全验证与确认进行了全面的综述与展望。我们将前人的工作归纳为基于断言的安全检查、覆盖率驱动的探索、对抗性测试、信息流跟踪、故障注入和侧信道导向评估。我们提供了仿真驱动的安全验证工作流的结构化视图，包括仪器化、激励生成、运行时监控和证据驱动分析。我们还审视了与可观测性、可扩展性、属性规范以及为基于仿真的验证定义面向安全的覆盖度量相关的实际挑战。最后，我们讨论了诸如人工智能辅助仿真、数字安全孪生、芯粒（chiplet）规模安全探索、自动化漏洞评估和云规模安全仿真等新兴方向。总的来说，本文将仿真定位为下一代前硅片硬件安全保证的基石。
AI.summary: 本文综述了基于硬件仿真的SoC安全验证技术。针对传统方法在应对复杂软硬件交互和对抗性威胁时的局限性，作者阐述了硬件仿真如何通过提供高吞吐量和高保真执行环境来提升安全验证能力。文章系统梳理了相关技术分类与工作流，分析了当前面临的实践挑战，并探讨了AI辅助和云端仿真等未来发展方向。
AI.keywords: SoC安全验证, 硬件仿真, 前硅片验证, 漏洞检测, 硬件安全
AI.comments: 该论文系统地梳理了基于硬件仿真的SoC安全验证领域，不仅涵盖了现有的核心技术和工作流，还前瞻性地指出了该领域面临的挑战及未来发展方向（如AI辅助和数字孪生），对于理解前硅片安全验证的演进具有重要的指导意义。

title: Trajectory Planning for a Multi-UAV Rigid-Payload Cascaded Transportation System Based on Enhanced Tube-RRT*
comments: 15 pages, 7 figures. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems (TAES). This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: This paper presents a two-stage trajectory planning framework for a multi-UAV rigid-payload cascaded transportation system, aiming to address planning challenges in densely cluttered environments. In Stage I, an Enhanced Tube-RRT* algorithm is developed by integrating active hybrid sampling and an adaptive expansion strategy, enabling rapid generation of a safe and feasible virtual tube in environments with dense obstacles. Moreover, a trajectory smoothness cost is explicitly incorporated into the edge cost to reduce excessive turns and thereby mitigate cable-induced oscillations. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed Enhanced Tube-RRT* achieves a higher success rate and effective sampling rate than mixed-sampling Tube-RRT* (STube-RRT*) and adaptive-extension Tube-RRT* (AETube-RRT*), while producing a shorter optimal path with a smaller cumulative turning angle. In Stage II, a convex quadratic program is formulated by considering payload translational and rotational dynamics, cable tension constraints, and collision-safety constraints, yielding a smooth, collision-free desired payload trajectory. Finally, a centralized geometric control scheme is applied to the cascaded system to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed planning framework, offering a practical solution for payload attitude maneuvering in densely cluttered environments.
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems (TAES). This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

AI.title_translation: 基于增强型Tube-RRT*的多无人机刚性负载级联运输系统轨迹规划
AI.tldr: 提出了一种两阶段轨迹规划框架，利用改进的Tube-RRT*算法和凸二次规划，实现了多无人机系统在复杂环境下的安全、平滑运输。
AI.motivation: 解决多无人机刚性负载级联运输系统在密集障碍物环境中轨迹规划困难的问题，旨在提高规划成功率并减少电缆引起的振荡。
AI.method: 提出了一种两阶段轨迹规划框架：第一阶段使用集成主动混合采样和自适应扩展策略的增强型Tube-RRT*生成虚拟管；第二阶段通过凸二次规划（QP）处理负载动力学、电缆张力和碰撞约束，生成平滑轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，增强型Tube-RRT*比现有算法具有更高的成功率和采样效率，生成的路径更短且转角更小；所提框架成功实现了复杂环境下的负载姿态机动。
AI.conclusion: 提出的两阶段规划框架能够为多无人机刚性负载级联运输系统提供安全、平滑且满足动力学约束的轨迹，在复杂环境下具有良好的实用性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于多无人机刚性负载级联运输系统的两阶段轨迹规划框架，旨在解决密集障碍物环境下的规划挑战。在第一阶段，开发了一种增强型Tube-RRT*算法，通过集成主动混合采样和自适应扩展策略，实现了在密集障碍物环境中快速生成安全可行的虚拟管。此外，将轨迹平滑度代价显式纳入边缘代价中，以减少过度的转弯，从而减轻电缆引起的振荡。仿真结果表明，所提出的增强型Tube-RRT*比混合采样Tube-RRT*(STube-RRT*)和自适应扩展Tube-RRT*(AETube-RRT*)具有更高的成功率和有效采样率，同时产生更短的最优路径和更小的累积转角。在第二阶段，通过考虑负载平移和旋转动力学、电缆张力约束及碰撞安全约束，构建了凸二次规划，从而得到平滑、无碰撞的期望负载轨迹。最后，将集中式几何控制方案应用于该级联系统，验证了所提规划框架的有效性和可行性，为密集障碍物环境下的负载姿态机动提供了实用的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文针对多无人机刚性负载运输系统，提出了一种两阶段轨迹规划方案。首先通过改进的Tube-RRT*在密集障碍物中生成安全路径，随后利用凸二次规划结合系统动力学和约束条件生成平滑轨迹，并通过几何控制验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 多无人机, 级联运输, 轨迹规划, Tube-RRT*, 动力学约束
AI.comments: 该研究通过两阶段法有效地解决了多无人机吊挂系统的协同规划问题，特别是在复杂障碍物环境下的路径规划与平滑控制方面表现出色，创新点在于改进了Tube-RRT*算法并结合了动力学约束优化。

title: Atropos: Improving Cost-Benefit Trade-off of LLM-based Agents under Self-Consistency with Early Termination and Model Hotswap
summary: Open-weight Small Language Models(SLMs) can provide faster local inference at lower financial cost, but may not achieve the same performance level as commercial Large Language Models (LLMs) that are orders of magnitudes larger. Consequently, many of the latest applications of LLMs, such as software engineering agents, tend to be evaluated on larger models only, leaving the issue of improving the cost-benefit trade-off of such applications neglected. This paper proposes Atropos, a predictive early-termination analysis and hotswap technique that aims to improve the cost-benefit trade-off for LLM-based agents that use self-consistency. The core component of ATROPOS is a predictive model based on structural properties of LLM inferences: after merging multiple agentic inference paths into a graph representation, ATROPOS uses Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) to predict whether an ongoing inference will eventually succeed or not. If an agentic task instance running on the source LLM is predicted to fail, ATROPOS subsequently performs hotswapping, i.e., migrating the on-going inference context onto the more capable target LLM: this is feasible because LLM contexts are stateless. An empirical evaluation of ATROPOS using three recent LLM-based agents shows that ATROPOS can predict early termination of eventually failing inferences with the accuracy of 0.85 at the midpoint of the inference. Hotswapping LLMs for such inferences can convert up to 27.57% of them to be successful. Consequently, ATROPOS achieves 74.35% of the performance of closed LLMs with as low as only 23.9% of the cost.

AI.title_translation: Atropos：通过早期终止和模型热切换改善基于自洽性的LLM智能体成本效益权衡
AI.tldr: Atropos通过预测推理失败并动态切换至更强模型，以不到四分之一的成本实现了高性能LLM智能体的大部分性能。
AI.motivation: 小型语言模型（SLM）成本低但性能不足，大型商用模型性能高但成本昂贵，现有研究缺乏对LLM智能体在自洽性推理中成本效益平衡的有效优化。
AI.method: 提出Atropos框架，首先将多个推理路径合并为图表示，利用图卷积网络（GCN）预测当前推理是否会失败；若预测失败，则将上下文迁移至更强大的目标LLM进行继续推理（热切换）。
AI.result: 实验表明，Atropos在推理中点预测失败的准确率达0.85；通过模型热切换，可使高达27.57%的失败推理转化为成功，最终以23.9%的成本达到了闭源大模型74.35%的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: Atropos通过早期终止和模型热切换技术，显著优化了LLM智能体的成本效益，在保持高性能的同时大幅降低了推理成本。
AI.translation: 开源小语言模型（SLM）能以更低的财务成本提供更快的本地推理，但可能无法达到规模大几个数量级的商业大语言模型（LLM）的性能水平。因此，许多最新的LLM应用（如软件工程智能体）往往只在大型模型上进行评估，导致改善此类应用成本效益权衡的问题被忽视。本文提出了Atropos，一种预测性早期终止分析和热切换技术，旨在改善使用自洽性的LLM智能体的成本效益权衡。Atropos的核心组件是一个基于LLM推理结构属性的预测模型：在将多个智能体推理路径合并为图表示后，Atropos使用图卷积网络（GCN）来预测正在进行的推理最终是否会成功。如果运行在源LLM上的智能体任务实例被预测为失败，Atropos随后执行热切换，即，将正在进行的推理上下文迁移到能力更强的目标LLM上：这是可行的，因为LLM上下文是无状态的。对使用三个最新LLM智能体进行的Atropos实证评估表明，Atropos可以在推理中点以0.85的准确率预测最终失败推理的早期终止。为此类推理热切换LLM可以将其中高达27.57%的推理转化为成功。因此，Atropos以低至23.9%的成本实现了闭源LLM 74.35%的性能。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Atropos，一种旨在提升自洽LLM智能体成本效益的框架。通过图卷积网络预测推理成功概率，并在必要时将上下文热切换至高性能模型，Atropos有效平衡了推理性能与财务成本。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 自洽性, 图神经网络, 早期终止, 模型热切换
AI.comments: Atropos通过结合图神经网络预测与动态模型切换，巧妙地解决了LLM智能体在自洽性（Self-Consistency）推理中的成本与性能平衡问题。其核心创新在于利用推理过程中的结构化信息进行早期干预，这为在资源受限的环境下部署高性能智能体提供了极具价值的工程实践参考。

title: NEAT-NC: NEAT guided Navigation Cells for Robot Path Planning
comments: To appear in short form in Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference (GECCO '26), 2026
summary: To navigate a space, the brain makes an internal representation of the environment using different cells such as place cells, grid cells, head direction cells, border cells, and speed cells. All these cells, along with sensory inputs, enable an organism to explore the space around it. Inspired by these biological principles, we developed NEATNC, a Neuro-Evolution of Augmenting Topology guided Navigation Cells. The goal of the paper is to improve NEAT algorithm performance in path planning in dynamic environments using spatial cognitive cells. This approach uses navigation cells as inputs and evolves recurrent neural networks, representing the hippocampus part of the brain. The performance of the proposed algorithm is evaluated in different static and dynamic scenarios. This study highlights NEAT's adaptability to complex and different environments, showcasing the utility of biological theories. This suggests that our approach is well-suited for real-time dynamic path planning for robotics and games.
comment: To appear in short form in Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference (GECCO '26), 2026

AI.title_translation: NEAT-NC：用于机器人路径规划的NEAT引导导航细胞方法
AI.tldr: 受生物大脑导航机制启发，本文提出了NEAT-NC算法，通过演化模拟海马体的循环神经网络，提升了机器人在动态环境中的路径规划性能。
AI.motivation: 受到生物大脑利用多种空间细胞进行环境导航的启发，旨在改善NEAT算法在处理动态环境路径规划时的性能和适应性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为NEAT-NC的方法，利用位置、网格、头部方向等空间认知细胞作为输入，通过神经进化算法（NEAT）演化循环神经网络（模拟海马体功能），以实现对动态环境的路径规划。
AI.result: 通过在多种静态和动态场景下的实验，证明了所提出的NEAT-NC算法能够有效适应复杂环境，表现出良好的路径规划能力。
AI.conclusion: NEAT-NC算法通过引入生物启发式的空间认知细胞，有效提升了NEAT在动态环境下的路径规划性能，证明了生物学理论在机器人与游戏领域应用的实用价值。
AI.translation: 为了导航空间，大脑利用位置细胞、网格细胞、头部方向细胞、边界细胞和速度细胞等不同细胞构建环境的内部表征。所有这些细胞连同感官输入，使生物体能够探索周围的空间。受这些生物学原理的启发，我们开发了NEAT-NC，即神经进化增强拓扑引导的导航细胞。本文的目标是利用空间认知细胞改善NEAT算法在动态环境路径规划中的性能。该方法使用导航细胞作为输入，并演化循环神经网络，代表大脑的海马体部分。所提算法的性能在不同的静态和动态场景中进行了评估。这项研究强调了NEAT对复杂和不同环境的适应性，展示了生物学理论的实用性。这表明我们的方法非常适合机器人和游戏的实时动态路径规划。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种仿生路径规划方法NEAT-NC，通过结合生物空间认知细胞与NEAT演化算法，构建模拟海马体功能的循环神经网络，从而显著提升了机器人在动态环境下的导航与路径规划效率。
AI.keywords: NEAT, 路径规划, 空间认知细胞, 循环神经网络, 生物启发式计算
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将生物学中的空间认知机制（如位置细胞、网格细胞等）与进化计算（NEAT）相结合，为解决机器人路径规划问题提供了一种新颖的仿生思路。其核心创新在于利用演化出的循环神经网络模拟海马体功能，从而增强机器人在动态环境中的适应能力。然而，论文未详细阐述该模型在处理极高维度环境或大规模复杂场景时的计算开销与可扩展性。

title: Where are the Humans? A Scoping Review of Fairness in Multi-agent AI Systems
comments: In proceedings of European Conference on Information Systems (ECIS) 2026
summary: Rapid advances in Generative AI are giving rise to increasingly sophisticated Multi-Agent AI (MAAI) systems. While AI fairness has been extensively studied in traditional predictive scenarios, its examination in MAAI remains nascent and fragmented. This scoping review critically synthesizes existing research on fairness in MAAI systems. Through a qualitative content analysis of 23 selected studies, we identify five archetypal approaches. Our findings reveal that fairness in MAAI systems is often addressed superficially, lacks robust normative foundations, and frequently overlooks the complex dynamics introduced by agent autonomy and system-level interactions. We argue that fairness must be embedded structurally throughout the development lifecycle of MAAI, rather than appended as a post-hoc consideration. Meaningful evaluation requires explicit human oversight, normative clarity, and a precise articulation of fairness objectives and beneficiaries. This review provides a foundation for advancing fairness research in MAAI systems by highlighting critical gaps, exposing prevailing limitations, and suggesting pathways.

AI.title_translation: 人类在哪里？多智能体人工智能系统公平性的范围综述
AI.tldr: 本文综述了多智能体AI系统公平性的研究现状，指出目前研究存在表面化和缺乏规范基础的问题，主张应将公平性融入系统开发的整个生命周期。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI的发展，多智能体AI系统日益复杂，但现有的公平性研究多局限于传统预测场景，缺乏对多智能体系统特有动态和自主性的深入探讨，因此需要对该领域的现状进行系统性综述。
AI.method: 通过定性内容分析法，对选定的23项关于多智能体AI系统公平性的研究进行了系统性梳理和综合。
AI.result: 研究发现，当前多智能体AI系统的公平性研究往往流于表面，缺乏规范基础，且忽视了智能体自主性和系统级交互带来的复杂性。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体AI系统的公平性研究目前尚处于初期且分散阶段，亟需建立更稳健的规范基础、明确公平性目标，并将公平性考量深度整合进整个开发生命周期。
AI.translation: 生成式AI的快速发展催生了日益复杂的多智能体人工智能（MAAI）系统。虽然AI公平性在传统的预测场景中已得到广泛研究，但其在MAAI中的探讨仍处于初期且分散的状态。本范围综述对现有的MAAI系统公平性研究进行了批判性综合。通过对23项精选研究进行定性内容分析，我们确定了五种原型方法。研究结果表明，MAAI系统中的公平性往往被浅层处理，缺乏稳健的规范基础，且经常忽视由智能体自主性和系统级交互所引入的复杂动态。我们认为，公平性必须结构化地嵌入到MAAI的开发生命周期中，而不是作为事后的考虑。有意义的评估需要明确的人类监督、规范的清晰度，以及对公平性目标和受益人的精确阐述。本综述通过突出关键差距、揭示现有局限并提出研究路径，为推进MAAI系统中的公平性研究奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文对多智能体AI（MAAI）系统中的公平性研究进行了范围综述。通过分析23项研究，作者指出当前该领域研究碎片化且缺乏深度，并提出了将公平性结构化嵌入系统开发全生命周期的必要性，强调了人类监管和规范性目标明确的重要性。
AI.keywords: 多智能体AI, 人工智能公平性, 范围综述, 系统交互, 人类监管
AI.comments: 该综述填补了多智能体AI系统公平性研究的空白，指出了当前研究在规范基础和复杂系统动态考量上的缺失。其核心贡献在于强调将公平性从“事后修补”转变为“结构化嵌入”，为后续研究提供了明确的方法论导向。

title: Codes with Large Minimum Distance in Product Codes: Explicit Constructions and Bounds
summary: Products of MDS codes are of major practical importance; for a recent example, they are used in Data Availability Sampling (DAS) in blockchain networks such as Celestia and as part of the Ethereum roadmap. This motivates us to consider subcodes of such codes with the goal of obtaining a larger minimum distance. In this paper, we present explicit constructions of subcodes of Reed--Solomon product codes, along with bounds on their minimum distance. In particular, they achieve an optimal or near-optimal dimension--distance tradeoff. For component codes of dimension $r$, our construction requires a field whose size is bounded linearly by the overall product code length, and attains the maximum possible minimum distance for subcode dimensions $r^2-1$, $r^2-2$, and all dimensions at most $2r-1$. Furthermore, we establish a new upper bound on the minimum distance of subcodes of the product of two codes with identical parameters.

AI.title_translation: 乘积码中具有大最小距离的编码：显式构造与界限
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Reed-Solomon乘积码的显式子码构造方法，在区块链数据可用性采样等应用中实现了最优的维度-距离权衡并推导了新的最小距离上界。
AI.motivation: MDS码的乘积码在区块链数据可用性采样（DAS）中具有重要应用，但传统乘积码的最小距离可能不足，因此需要研究如何通过构造其子码来获得更大的最小距离。
AI.method: 通过构造Reed-Solomon乘积码的子码，利用线性界限的域大小要求，在特定子码维度（如r^2-1, r^2-2及小于等于2r-1）下实现最优或近最优的维度-距离权衡，并推导了相同参数乘积码子码的最小距离上界。
AI.result: 在组件码维度为r的情况下，构造出的子码在特定维度（r^2-1, r^2-2及≤2r-1）达到最大可能的最小距离，且所需域大小与乘积码长度呈线性关系；同时提出了乘积码子码最小距离的新上界。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功为Reed-Solomon乘积码提供了显式子码构造，在特定维度下实现了最优最小距离，并确立了新的理论界限，为纠错码在实际分布式系统中的应用提供了有力支持。
AI.translation: MDS码的乘积码具有重大的实际意义；例如，它们被用于Celestia和以太坊路线图等区块链网络中的数据可用性采样（DAS）。这促使我们考虑此类编码的子码，目标是获得更大的最小距离。在本文中，我们提出了Reed-Solomon乘积码子码的显式构造，以及关于其最小距离的界限。特别是，它们实现了最优或近最优的维度-距离权衡。对于维度为r的组件码，我们的构造要求域的大小在总体乘积码长度的线性范围内，并在子码维度为r^2-1、r^2-2以及所有小于等于2r-1的维度下，达到了最大可能的最小距离。此外，我们为具有相同参数的两个码的乘积的子码的最小距离建立了一个新的上界。
AI.summary: 本文研究了Reed-Solomon乘积码的子码构造问题，旨在提升其最小距离以满足区块链DAS等应用需求。作者提出了显式构造方法，在保持最优或近最优维度-距离权衡的同时，确定了特定维度下的最优最小距离，并推导了新的理论上界。
AI.keywords: 乘积码, Reed-Solomon码, 最小距离, 数据可用性采样, 区块链
AI.comments: 该论文针对区块链领域（如Celestia和以太坊）中数据可用性采样（DAS）对纠错码的实际需求，提出了创新的子码构造方法。其核心贡献在于在保持高效译码潜力的同时，显著提升了乘积码的最小距离，并给出了理论上限，对分布式存储和区块链协议优化具有重要指导意义。

title: Autonomous Evolution of EDA Tools: Multi-Agent Self-Evolved ABC
summary: This paper introduces the first \emph{self-evolving} logic synthesis framework, which leverages Large Language Model (LLM) agents to autonomously improve the source code of \textsc{ABC}, the widely adopted logic synthesis system. Our framework operates on the \emph{entire integrated ABC codebase}, and the output repository preserves its single-binary execution model and command interface. In the initial evolution cycle, we bootstrap the system using existing prior open-source synthesis components, covering flow tuning, logic minimization, and technology mapping, but without manually injecting new heuristics. On top of this foundation, a team of LLM-based agents iteratively rewrites and evolves specific sub-components of ABC following our ``programming guidance`` prompts under a unified correctness and QoR-driven evaluation loop. Each evolution cycle proposes code modifications, compiles the integrated binary, validates correctness, and evaluates quality-of-results (QoR) on \emph{multi-suite benchmarks including ISCAS~85/89/99, VTR, EPFL, and IWLS~2005}. Through continuous feedback, the system discovers optimizations beyond human-designed heuristics, effectively \emph{learning new synthesis strategies} that enhance QoR. We detail the architecture of this self-improving system, its integration with \textsc{ABC}, and results demonstrating that the framework can autonomously and progressively improve EDA tool at full million-line scale.

AI.title_translation: EDA工具的自主演进：多代理自我演进ABC系统
AI.tldr: 利用LLM代理自动重写并优化百万行规模的ABC逻辑合成工具代码，实现了EDA算法的自主演进与质量提升。
AI.motivation: 传统EDA工具的启发式算法开发依赖于极高的人力成本和专家经验，开发周期长且难以维护。作者旨在通过引入LLM代理实现EDA工具的自主演进，以降低开发门槛并提升逻辑合成质量。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于多LLM代理的自我演进框架，通过统一的正确性和质量（QoR）驱动的评估循环，对ABC逻辑合成系统的源代码进行迭代式重写与优化。该过程涵盖了从代码修改、编译、验证到多基准测试评估的全自动化流程。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该框架能在百万行代码规模下自主且持续地改进ABC工具，成功发现了优于人工设计的启发式策略，并显著提升了在多个基准测试集上的逻辑合成质量（QoR）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了LLM代理能够自主且渐进地优化大规模EDA代码库，为未来自动化EDA工具开发开辟了新路径。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了首个“自我演进”的逻辑合成框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）代理自主改进广泛采用的逻辑合成系统ABC的源代码。我们的框架作用于整个ABC集成代码库，且输出的存储库保留了其单二进制执行模型和命令接口。在初始演进周期中，我们使用现有的开源合成组件（涵盖流程调整、逻辑最小化和技术映射）启动系统，而无需手动注入新的启发式算法。在此基础上，一个基于LLM的代理团队遵循我们的“编程指导”提示，在统一的正确性和QoR驱动的评估循环下，迭代地重写和演进ABC的具体子组件。每个演进周期都会提出代码修改建议、编译集成二进制文件、验证正确性，并在包括ISCAS 85/89/99、VTR、EPFL和IWLS 2005在内的多个基准测试套件上评估结果质量（QoR）。通过持续反馈，系统发现了超越人工设计启发式算法的优化方案，有效地学习了能提升QoR的新合成策略。我们详细介绍了该自我改进系统的架构、其与ABC的集成，以及证明该框架能够在百万行规模下自主且渐进地改进EDA工具的实验结果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了首个用于逻辑合成系统ABC的自我演进框架。该框架利用多LLM代理自动优化百万行级的代码库，通过闭环的正确性验证与QoR评估，在无需人工干预的情况下自主学习并实现更优的合成策略。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 逻辑合成, EDA工具, 自主演进, 代理系统
AI.comments: 这是一项开创性工作，首次展示了利用大语言模型代理自主改进大规模复杂EDA工具代码的能力。其创新点在于将LLM的应用从辅助编程提升到了自主演进系统架构层面，且无需人工干预即可发现新的合成策略。局限性在于该方法对计算资源消耗较高，且在极度复杂的逻辑合成场景下的演进稳定性和代码可维护性仍需长期观察。

title: ControlFoley: Unified and Controllable Video-to-Audio Generation with Cross-Modal Conflict Handling
summary:
Recent advances in video-to-audio (V2A) generation enable high-quality audio synthesis from visual content, yet achieving robust and fine-grained controllability remains challenging. Existing methods suffer from weak textual controllability under visual-text conflict and imprecise stylistic control due to entangled temporal and timbre information in reference audio. Moreover, the lack of standardized benchmarks limits systematic evaluation.
  We propose ControlFoley, a unified multimodal V2A framework that enables precise control over video, text, and reference audio. We introduce a joint visual encoding paradigm that integrates CLIP with a spatio-temporal audio-visual encoder to improve alignment and textual controllability. We further propose temporal-timbre decoupling to suppress redundant temporal cues while preserving discriminative timbre features. In addition, we design a modality-robust training scheme with unified multimodal representation alignment (REPA) and random modality dropout. We also present VGGSound-TVC, a benchmark for evaluating textual controllability under varying degrees of visual-text conflict.
  Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across multiple V2A tasks, including text-guided, text-controlled, and audio-controlled generation. ControlFoley achieves superior controllability under cross-modal conflict while maintaining strong synchronization and audio quality, and shows competitive or better performance compared to an industrial V2A system.
  Code, models, datasets, and demos are available at: https://yjx-research.github.io/ControlFoley/.

AI.title_translation: ControlFoley：具有跨模态冲突处理能力的统一且可控的视频到音频生成框架
AI.tldr: ControlFoley 是一种新型 V2A 框架，通过解耦音色与时间特征及增强模态鲁棒性，解决了视频与文本/音频冲突时的精准控制难题。
AI.motivation: 现有的 V2A 方法在处理视觉-文本冲突时文本控制力较弱，且参考音频的时频特征缠绕导致风格控制不精确，同时缺乏标准化的基准评估体系。
AI.method: 1. 联合视觉编码：集成 CLIP 与时空音视频编码器以增强对齐；2. 时频解耦：分离时间与音色特征，抑制冗余信息；3. 模态鲁棒训练：采用多模态表示对齐（REPA）与随机模态丢弃策略。
AI.result: 在多项 V2A 任务中达到 SOTA 水平，特别是在处理跨模态冲突时表现出优异的控制力，且在音画同步和音质方面表现出色，优于或媲美工业级系统。
AI.conclusion: ControlFoley 提供了一个统一且鲁棒的 V2A 框架，通过联合编码、时频解耦和模态鲁棒训练，在处理复杂跨模态冲突时展现了卓越的控制能力和音画同步效果。
AI.translation: 最近视频到音频（V2A）生成的进展使得从视觉内容合成高质量音频成为可能，但实现鲁棒且细粒度的可控性仍然具有挑战性。现有方法在视觉-文本冲突下文本可控性较弱，且由于参考音频中时间与音色信息的纠缠，导致风格控制不精确。此外，缺乏标准化基准限制了系统评估。我们提出了 ControlFoley，一个统一的多模态 V2A 框架，能够实现对视频、文本和参考音频的精确控制。我们引入了一种联合视觉编码范式，集成了 CLIP 与时空音视频编码器，以提高对齐和文本可控性。我们进一步提出了时频解耦，以抑制冗余的时间线索，同时保留判别性音色特征。此外，我们设计了一种具有统一多模态表示对齐（REPA）和随机模态丢弃的模态鲁棒训练方案。我们还提出了 VGGSound-TVC，这是一个用于评估不同程度视觉-文本冲突下文本可控性的基准。大量实验表明，该方法在包括文本引导、文本控制和音频控制生成在内的多项 V2A 任务中实现了最先进的性能。ControlFoley 在跨模态冲突下实现了卓越的可控性，同时保持了强大的同步性和音频质量，并表现出与工业 V2A 系统相比具有竞争性或更好的性能。代码、模型、数据集和演示可在 https://yjx-research.github.io/ControlFoley/ 获取。
AI.summary: ControlFoley 是一个统一的 V2A 框架，通过引入联合视觉编码、时频解耦和鲁棒的模态训练方案，实现了对视频、文本和参考音频的精确控制，并提出了新的基准测试以评估跨模态冲突下的控制能力。
AI.keywords: 视频到音频生成, 跨模态控制, 时频解耦, 多模态对齐, 模态鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文针对视频到音频生成（V2A）领域中长期存在的跨模态冲突控制和细粒度风格控制难题，提出了创新的解耦与对齐机制。其最大的亮点在于不仅优化了生成质量，还通过构建专门的基准测试集（VGGSound-TVC）解决了该领域评估标准缺失的问题，具有很高的实用价值和学术参考意义。

title: Building Extraction from Remote Sensing Imagery under Hazy and Low-light Conditions: Benchmark and Baseline
summary: Building extraction from optical Remote Sensing (RS) imagery suffers from performance degradation under real-world hazy and low-light conditions. However, existing optical methods and benchmarks focus primarily on ideal clear-weather conditions. While SAR offers all-weather sensing, its side-looking geometry causes geometric distortions. To address these challenges, we introduce HaLoBuilding, the first optical benchmark specifically designed for building extraction under hazy and low-light conditions. By leveraging a same-scene multitemporal pairing strategy, we ensure pixel-level label alignment and high fidelity even under extreme degradation. Building upon this benchmark, we propose HaLoBuild-Net, a novel end-to-end framework for building extraction in adverse RS scenarios. At its core, we develop a Spatial-Frequency Focus Module (SFFM) to effectively mitigate meteorological interference on building features by coupling large receptive field attention with frequency-aware channel reweighting guided by stable low-frequency anchors. Additionally, a Global Multi-scale Guidance Module (GMGM) provides global semantic constraints to anchor building topologies, while a Mutual-Guided Fusion Module (MGFM) implements bidirectional semantic-spatial calibration to suppress shallow noise and sharpen weather-induced blurred boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HaLoBuild-Net significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods and conventional cascaded restoration-segmentation paradigms on the HaLoBuilding dataset, while maintaining robust generalization on WHU, INRIA, and LoveDA datasets. The source code and datasets are publicly available at: https://github.com/AeroVILab-AHU/HaLoBuilding.

AI.title_translation: 雾霾与低光条件下的遥感影像建筑提取：基准与基线研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对雾霾和低光环境的遥感建筑提取基准数据集HaLoBuilding，并设计了HaLoBuild-Net框架，通过多维度特征优化显著提升了恶劣天气下的建筑识别效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的光学遥感建筑提取方法多针对理想天气，在雾霾和低光条件下性能严重下降；而SAR影像又存在几何畸变。因此需要构建针对恶劣环境的基准数据集并开发配套的提取算法。
AI.method: 提出了HaLoBuilding数据集，并设计了HaLoBuild-Net框架。该框架包含三个核心模块：空间-频率聚焦模块（SFFM）用于抑制气象干扰；全局多尺度引导模块（GMGM）用于约束建筑拓扑；以及互引导融合模块（MGFM）用于去噪和边界锐化。
AI.result: 实验表明，HaLoBuild-Net在HaLoBuilding数据集上显著优于现有的前沿方法及级联恢复-分割范式，并在WHU、INRIA和LoveDA数据集上表现出稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: HaLoBuild-Net在复杂气象条件下表现出优越的建筑提取性能，且在常规数据集上展现了良好的泛化能力，为解决遥感图像恶劣环境下的视觉任务提供了有效范式。
AI.translation: 光学遥感（RS）图像的建筑提取在现实世界的雾霾和低光条件下性能会下降。然而，现有的光学方法和基准主要集中在理想的晴朗天气条件下。虽然合成孔径雷达（SAR）提供了全天候感知能力，但其侧视几何结构导致了几何畸变。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了HaLoBuilding，这是第一个专门为雾霾和低光条件下的建筑提取而设计的遥感基准。通过利用同场景多时相配对策略，我们确保了像素级的标签对齐，即使在极端退化下也能保持高保真度。基于该基准，我们提出了HaLoBuild-Net，这是一个用于恶劣遥感场景下建筑提取的新型端到端框架。其核心是开发了一个空间-频率聚焦模块（SFFM），通过将大感受野注意力与由稳定低频锚点引导的频率感知通道重加权相结合，有效减轻了气象干扰对建筑特征的影响。此外，全局多尺度引导模块（GMGM）提供了全局语义约束以锚定建筑拓扑，而互引导融合模块（MGFM）实现了双向语义-空间校准，以抑制浅层噪声并锐化受天气影响的模糊边界。广泛的实验表明，HaLoBuild-Net在HaLoBuilding数据集上显著优于现有的最先进方法和传统的级联恢复-分割范式，同时在WHU、INRIA和LoveDA数据集上保持了稳健的泛化能力。源代码和数据集已在GitHub公开。
AI.summary: 本文针对雾霾和低光环境下的遥感建筑提取难题，构建了首个名为HaLoBuilding的专用基准数据集。在此基础上，提出了端到端的HaLoBuild-Net框架，通过结合空间-频率聚焦、全局多尺度引导及互引导融合技术，有效克服了气象干扰，提升了复杂场景下的提取精度。
AI.keywords: 建筑提取, 遥感图像, 雾霾与低光, 深度学习, 基准数据集
AI.comments: 该论文针对遥感领域在复杂天气（雾霾、低光）下的建筑提取难题，填补了该场景下基准数据集的空白。创新点在于提出了专门的SFFM、GMGM和MGFM模块，通过频域分析和多尺度引导增强了特征鲁棒性。该研究对于提升遥感图像在极端环境下的实际应用价值具有重要意义。

title: Beyond Visual Cues: Semantic-Driven Token Filtering and Expert Routing for Anytime Person ReID
summary: Any-Time Person Re-identification (AT-ReID) necessitates the robust retrieval of target individuals under arbitrary conditions, encompassing both modality shifts (daytime and nighttime) and extensive clothing-change scenarios, ranging from short-term to long-term intervals. However, existing methods are highly relying on pure visual features, which are prone to change due to environmental and time factors, resulting in significantly performance deterioration under scenarios involving illumination caused modality shifts or cloth-change. In this paper, we propose Semantic-driven Token Filtering and Expert Routing (STFER), a novel framework that leverages the ability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to generate identity consistency text, which provides identity-discriminative features that are robust to both clothing variations and cross-modality shifts between RGB and IR. Specifically, we employ instructions to guide the LVLM in generating identity-intrinsic semantic text that captures biometric constants for the semantic model driven. The text token is further used for Semantic-driven Visual Token Filtering (SVTF), which enhances informative visual regions and suppresses redundant background noise. Meanwhile, the text token is also used for Semantic-driven Expert Routing (SER), which integrates the semantic text into expert routing, resulting in more robust multi-scenario gating. Extensive experiments on the Any-Time ReID dataset (AT-USTC) demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art results. Moreover, the model trained on AT-USTC was evaluated across 5 widely-used ReID benchmarks demonstrating superior generalization capabilities with highly competitive results. Our code will be available soon.

AI.title_translation: 超越视觉线索：面向任意时刻行人重识别的语义驱动Token过滤与专家路由方法
AI.tldr: 为解决行人重识别在光照和衣物变化下的性能难题，本文引入语义驱动的STFER框架，利用大语言模型辅助视觉特征处理，显著提升了识别准确率与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的Any-Time Person ReID方法过分依赖纯视觉特征，在处理光照导致的模态差异（如RGB与IR）以及长短期衣物更换场景时，性能会显著下降。
AI.method: 提出了STFER框架。首先利用LVLM生成身份一致性文本以捕获生物特征常量；其次通过语义驱动视觉Token过滤（SVTF）增强视觉特征并去除噪声；最后通过语义驱动专家路由（SER）实现鲁棒的多场景门控。
AI.result: 在AT-USTC数据集上达到了SOTA水平，并在5个广泛使用的ReID基准测试中表现出卓越的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: STFER框架通过引入语义驱动的Token过滤与专家路由机制，有效解决了Any-Time Person ReID中的模态切换和衣物更换难题，达到了SOTA水平，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 任意时刻行人重识别（AT-ReID）需要在任意条件下对目标个体进行鲁棒检索，这涵盖了模态切换（白天和夜晚）以及广泛的衣物更换场景（从短期到长期）。然而，现有的方法高度依赖纯视觉特征，这些特征容易因环境和时间因素而改变，导致在涉及光照导致的模态切换或衣物更换的场景中性能显著下降。在本文中，我们提出了语义驱动Token过滤与专家路由（STFER），这是一个利用大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）生成身份一致性文本的新型框架，它提供了对衣物变化和RGB与IR之间跨模态切换均具有鲁棒性的身份判别特征。具体而言，我们使用指令引导LVLM生成捕获生物特征常量的身份内在语义文本，用于语义模型驱动。文本Token进一步用于语义驱动视觉Token过滤（SVTF），该技术增强了信息丰富的视觉区域并抑制了冗余的背景噪声。同时，文本Token还用于语义驱动专家路由（SER），将语义文本集成到专家路由中，从而实现更稳健的多场景门控。在Any-Time ReID数据集（AT-USTC）上的大量实验证明，我们的模型达到了最先进的结果。此外，在AT-USTC上训练的模型在5个广泛使用的ReID基准测试中进行了评估，证明了其卓越的泛化能力和极具竞争力的结果。我们的代码即将发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了STFER框架，旨在解决Any-Time Person ReID在光照模态切换和衣物变化场景下的性能瓶颈。通过利用LVLM生成身份相关的语义文本，STFER实现了对视觉Token的有效过滤以及专家路由的精准控制，从而在多种复杂条件下实现了稳健的行人重识别。
AI.keywords: Any-Time Person ReID, 大视觉语言模型, 语义驱动, 特征过滤, 专家路由
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）来弥补纯视觉特征在复杂场景下的局限性，通过语义引导来增强对身份特征的鲁棒性。其核心优势在于能够同时解决光照模态切换和衣物更换带来的干扰。不过，依赖LVLM可能导致计算开销增加，且对提示词（Instruction）的依赖程度如何影响泛化性值得进一步探讨。

title: OpenMobile: Building Open Mobile Agents with Task and Trajectory Synthesis
summary: Mobile agents powered by vision-language models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in automating mobile tasks, with recent leading models achieving a marked performance leap, e.g., nearly 70% success on AndroidWorld. However, these systems keep their training data closed and remain opaque about their task and trajectory synthesis recipes. We present OpenMobile, an open-source framework that synthesizes high-quality task instructions and agent trajectories, with two key components: (1) The first is a scalable task synthesis pipeline that constructs a global environment memory from exploration, then leverages it to generate diverse and grounded instructions. and (2) a policy-switching strategy for trajectory rollout. By alternating between learner and expert models, it captures essential error-recovery data often missing in standard imitation learning. Agents trained on our data achieve competitive results across three dynamic mobile agent benchmarks: notably, our fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL reach 51.7% and 64.7% on AndroidWorld, far surpassing existing open-data approaches. Furthermore, we conduct transparent analyses on the overlap between our synthetic instructions and benchmark test sets, and verify that performance gains stem from broad functionality coverage rather than benchmark overfitting. We release data and code at https://njucckevin.github.io/openmobile/ to bridge the data gap and facilitate broader mobile agent research.

AI.title_translation: 开放移动：通过任务和轨迹合成构建开放移动代理
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了OpenMobile，一个开源框架，用于合成高质量的任务指令和代理轨迹，以改进移动代理的训练。该框架包含一个可扩展的任务合成管道和一个策略切换策略。使用OpenMobile合成的数据训练的模型在AndroidWorld等基准测试中取得了具有竞争力的结果，并且通过透明分析证明了性能提升源于广泛的功能覆盖而非基准过拟合。研究人员公开发布了数据和代码。
AI.motivation: 现有的移动代理研究虽然能力强大，但其训练数据不公开，任务和轨迹合成方法不透明，阻碍了该领域的进一步发展和复现。因此，需要一个开放的框架来合成高质量的训练数据，并促进对模型性能提升原因的透明分析。
AI.method: OpenMobile框架包含两个关键组件：1. 一个可扩展的任务合成管道，通过探索构建全局环境记忆，然后利用该记忆生成多样化且有根据的指令。2. 一个用于轨迹滚动的策略切换策略，通过在学习者模型和专家模型之间切换，捕获标准模仿学习中通常缺失的关键错误恢复数据。
AI.result: 在AndroidWorld基准测试中，使用OpenMobile合成的数据微调的Qwen2.5-VL和Qwen3-VL模型分别达到了51.7%和64.7%的成功率，显著优于现有的开放数据方法。此外，研究还进行了透明的分析，证明了性能提升是由于广泛的功能覆盖，而非基准测试过拟合。
AI.conclusion: OpenMobile框架成功地合成了高质量的任务指令和代理轨迹，显著提升了移动代理在基准测试中的性能，并提供了对性能提升原因的透明分析，有助于弥合数据差距，促进移动代理的广泛研究。
AI.translation: 由视觉语言模型驱动的移动代理在自动化移动任务方面展现了令人印象深刻的能力，最近领先的模型取得了显著的性能飞跃，例如在AndroidWorld上成功率接近70%。然而，这些系统将其训练数据保密，并且对其任务和轨迹合成方法不透明。我们提出了OpenMobile，一个开源框架，用于合成高质量的任务指令和代理轨迹，包含两个关键组件：(1) 第一个是可扩展的任务合成管道，它通过探索构建全局环境记忆，然后利用该记忆生成多样化且有根据的指令。和 (2) 用于轨迹滚动的策略切换策略。通过在学习者和专家模型之间切换，它捕获了标准模仿学习中通常缺失的关键错误恢复数据。我们在三个动态移动代理基准测试中使用了我们合成的数据进行训练的代理取得了具有竞争力的结果：特别是，我们微调的Qwen2.5-VL和Qwen3-VL在AndroidWorld上的成功率达到了51.7%和64.7%，远远超过了现有的开放数据方法。此外，我们对我们合成的指令与基准测试集之间的重叠进行了透明的分析，并验证了性能提升源于广泛的功能覆盖，而不是基准测试过拟合。我们在https://njucckevin.github.io/openmobile/ 上发布了数据和代码，以弥合数据差距并促进更广泛的移动代理研究。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了OpenMobile，一个开源框架，旨在通过合成高质量的任务指令和代理轨迹来解决当前移动代理研究中数据不公开和方法不透明的问题。OpenMobile包含一个创新的任务合成管道和一个策略切换机制，用于生成多样化且包含错误恢复信息的训练数据。实验结果表明，使用OpenMobile合成的数据训练的模型在多个基准测试中取得了领先的性能，并且研究通过透明分析证实了其有效性，而非过拟合。
AI.keywords: 移动代理, 任务合成, 轨迹合成, 开源框架, 视觉语言模型
AI.comments: OpenMobile框架在解决移动代理研究中的数据开放性和方法透明性方面迈出了重要一步。其创新的任务合成和策略切换方法为生成高质量训练数据提供了新的思路。然而，未来可以进一步探索该框架在更广泛的移动环境和更复杂的任务类型上的泛化能力，以及对合成数据质量的更细致评估。

title: Beyond Independent Frames: Latent Attention Masked Autoencoders for Multi-View Echocardiography
comments: Accepted as a workshop paper at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Science
summary: Echocardiography is a widely used modality for cardiac assessment due to its non-invasive and cost-effective nature, but the sparse and heterogeneous spatiotemporal views of the heart pose distinct challenges. Existing masked autoencoder (MAE) approaches typically process images or short clips independently, failing to capture the inherent multi-view structure required for coherent cardiac representation. We introduce Latent Attention Masked Autoencoder (LAMAE), a foundation model architecture tailored to the multi-view nature of medical imaging. LAMAE augments the standard MAE with a latent attention module that enables information exchange across frames and views directly in latent space. This allows the model to aggregate variable-length sequences and distinct views, reconstructing a holistic representation of cardiac function from partial observations. We pretrain LAMAE on MIMIC-IV-ECHO, a large-scale, uncurated dataset reflecting real-world clinical variability. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first results for predicting ICD-10 codes from MIMIC-IV-ECHO videos. Furthermore, we empirically demonstrate that representations learned from adult data transfer effectively to pediatric cohorts despite substantial anatomical differences. These results provide evidence that incorporating structural priors, such as multi-view attention, yields significantly more robust and transferable representations.

title: From Procedural Skills to Strategy Genes: Towards Experience-Driven Test-Time Evolution
summary: This beta technical report asks how reusable experience should be represented so that it can function as effective test-time control and as a substrate for iterative evolution. We study this question in 4.590 controlled trials across 45 scientific code-solving scenarios. We find that documentation-oriented Skill packages provide unstable control: their useful signal is sparse, and expanding a compact experience object into a fuller documentation package often fails to help and can degrade the overall average. We further show that representation itself is a first-order factor. A compact Gene representation yields the strongest overall average, remains competitive under substantial structural perturbations, and outperforms matched-budget Skill fragments, while reattaching documentation-oriented material usually weakens rather than improves it. Beyond one-shot control, we show that Gene is also a better carrier for iterative experience accumulation: attached failure history is more effective in Gene than in Skill or freeform text, editable structure matters beyond content alone, and failure information is most useful when distilled into compact warnings rather than naively appended. On CritPt, gene-evolved systems improve over their paired base models from 9.1% to 18.57% and from 17.7% to 27.14%. These results suggest that the core problem in experience reuse is not how to supply more experience, but how to encode experience as a compact, control-oriented, evolution-ready object.

title: Metric-agnostic Learning-to-Rank via Boosting and Rank Approximation
summary: Learning-to-Rank (LTR) is a supervised machine learning approach that constructs models specifically designed to order a set of items or documents based on their relevance or importance to a given query or context. Despite significant success in real-world information retrieval systems, current LTR methods rely on one prefix ranking metric (e.g., such as Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG) or Mean Average Precision (MAP)) for optimizing the ranking objective function. Such metric-dependent setting limits LTR methods from two perspectives: (1) non-differentiable problem: directly optimizing ranking functions over a given ranking metric is inherently non-smooth, making the training process unstable and inefficient; (2) limited ranking utility: optimizing over one single metric makes it difficult to generalize well to other ranking metrics of interest. To address the above issues, we propose a novel listwise LTR framework for efficient and generalizable ranking purpose. Specifically, we propose a new differentiable ranking loss that combines a smooth approximation to the ranking operator with the average mean square loss per query. Then, we adapt gradient-boosting machines to minimize our proposed loss with respect to each list, a novel contribution. Finally, extensive experimental results confirm that our method outperforms the current state-of-the-art in information retrieval measures with similar efficiency.

title: Data Engineering Patterns for Cross-System Reconciliation in Regulated Enterprises: Architecture, Anomaly Detection, and Governance
comments: 13 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Practitioner reference paper. Code and supplementary materials: https://github.com/andersonqiu/GERA-Framework
summary: Regulated enterprises in the United States -- banks, telecommunications providers, large technology companies -- operate across heterogeneous systems that were rarely designed to interoperate. ERP platforms, billing engines, supply chain tools, and financial reporting infrastructure coexist within the same organization, but they do not talk to each other well. The resulting fragmentation produces familiar problems: transactions recorded in one system but unreconciled in another, asset inventories drifting from their systems of record, and audit-readiness that depends on manual effort. The PCAOB's 2024 inspection cycle put a number on the consequences: a 39% aggregate Part I.A deficiency rate across all inspected firms. This paper introduces the GERA Framework (Governed Enterprise Reconciliation Architecture) -- a vendor-neutral, four-layer data architecture that integrates deterministic cross-system reconciliation, statistical anomaly detection (baseline Z-Score with robust alternatives), governed semantic standardization, and NIST CSF 2.0-aligned security controls into a single methodology. The architecture spans four layers (ingestion, staging, core models, and semantic serving), following the multi-layer pattern now common in modern data platforms. The patterns are demonstrated through U.S. broadband operations -- where billing reconciliation, inventory aging, and governance are tightly coupled -- and draw on the author's implementation experience across three regulated enterprise environments: a regional bank, a national broadband provider, and a Fortune 500 technology company's central finance organization. This is a practitioner reference -- an architectural framework paper documenting field-tested patterns -- not a controlled experiment or benchmark study. No proprietary systems, datasets, or internal implementations are disclosed.

title: IUQ: Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification for Long-Form Large Language Model Generation
summary: Despite the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), uncertainty quantification in LLM generation is a persistent challenge. Although recent approaches have achieved strong performance by restricting LLMs to produce short or constrained answer sets, many real-world applications require long-form and free-form text generation. A key difficulty in this setting is that LLMs often produce responses that are semantically coherent yet factually inaccurate, while the underlying semantics are multifaceted and the linguistic structure is complex. To tackle this challenge, this paper introduces Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification (IUQ), a novel framework that leverages inter-sample consistency and intra-sample faithfulness to quantify the uncertainty in long-form LLM outputs. By utilizing an interrogate-then-respond paradigm, our method provides reliable measures of claim-level uncertainty and the model's faithfulness. Experimental results across diverse model families and model sizes demonstrate the superior performance of IUQ over two widely used long-form generation datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/louisfanhz/IUQ.

title: HyperSpace: A Generalized Framework for Spatial Encoding in Hyperdimensional Representations
summary: Vector Symbolic Architectures (VSAs) provide a well-defined algebraic framework for compositional representations in hyperdimensional spaces. We introduce HyperSpace, an open-source framework that decomposes VSA systems into modular operators for encoding, binding, bundling, similarity, cleanup, and regression. Using HyperSpace, we analyze and benchmark two representative VSA backends: Holographic Reduced Representations (HRR) and Fourier Holographic Reduced Representations (FHRR). Although FHRR provides lower theoretical complexity for individual operations, HyperSpaces modularity reveals that similarity and cleanup dominate runtime in spatial domains. As a result, HRR and FHRR exhibit comparable end-to-end performance. Differences in memory footprint introduce additional deployment trade-offs where HRR requires approximately half the memory of FHRR vectors. By enabling modular, system-level evaluation, HyperSpace reveals practical trade-offs in VSA pipelines that are not apparent from theoretical or operator-level comparisons alone.

title: FedIDM: Achieving Fast and Stable Convergence in Byzantine Federated Learning through Iterative Distribution Matching
summary: Most existing Byzantine-robust federated learning (FL) methods suffer from slow and unstable convergence. Moreover, when handling a substantial proportion of colluded malicious clients, achieving robustness typically entails compromising model utility. To address these issues, this work introduces FedIDM, which employs distribution matching to construct trustworthy condensed data for identifying and filtering abnormal clients. FedIDM consists of two main components: (1) attack-tolerant condensed data generation, and (2) robust aggregation with negative contribution-based rejection. These components exclude local updates that (1) deviate from the update direction derived from condensed data, or (2) cause a significant loss on the condensed dataset. Comprehensive evaluations on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that FedIDM achieves fast and stable convergence while maintaining acceptable model utility, under multiple state-of-the-art Byzantine attacks involving a large number of malicious clients.

title: Asymptotic gauge-invariant Hybrid High-Order method for magnetic Schrödinger equations
summary: We introduce a Hybrid High-Order (HHO) method for the Schrödinger equation in the presence of a magnetic vector potential. In quantum mechanics, physical observables are invariant under continuous gauge transformations, which must be kept at the discrete level to avoid unphysical artifacts. To address this, we construct a discrete covariant gradient operator on arbitrary polyhedral meshes. We prove that the resulting discrete bilinear form guarantees gauge covariance asymptotically at the discrete level. The resulting scheme achieves optimal convergence rates and preserves a discrete Garding inequality, guaranteeing a stable ground state. The theoretical properties of the scheme are corroborated by numerical experiments, including the computation of the Fock-Darwin fundamental energy and replicating the Aharonov-Bohm effect.

title: NFTDELTA: Detecting Permission Control Vulnerabilities in NFT Contracts through Multi-View Learning
summary: Permission control vulnerabilities in Non-fungible token (NFT) contracts can result in significant financial losses, as attackers may exploit these weaknesses to gain unauthorized access or circumvent critical permission checks. In this paper, we propose NFTDELTA, a framework that leverages static analysis and multi-view learning to detect permission control vulnerabilities in NFT contracts. Specifically, we extract comprehensive function Control Flow Graph (CFG) information via two views: sequence features (representing execution paths) and graph features (capturing structural control flow). These two views are then integrated to create a unified code representation. We also define three specific categories of permission control vulnerabilities and employ a custom detector to identify defects through multi-view feature similarity analysis. Our evaluation of 795 popular NFT collections identified 241 confirmed permission control vulnerabilities, comprising 214 cases of Bypass Auth Reentrancy, 15 of Weak Auth Validation, and 12 of Loose Permission Management. Manual verification demonstrates the detector's high reliability, achieving an average precision of 97.92% and an F1-score of 81.09%. Furthermore, NFTDELTA demonstrates enhanced efficiency and scalability, proving its effectiveness in securing NFT ecosystems.

title: SRMU: Relevance-Gated Updates for Streaming Hyperdimensional Memories
summary: Sequential associative memories (SAMs) are difficult to build and maintain in real-world streaming environments, where observations arrive incrementally over time, have imbalanced sampling, and non-stationary temporal dynamics. Vector Symbolic Architectures (VSAs) provide a biologically-inspired framework for building SAMs. Entities and attributes are encoded as quasi-orthogonal hyperdimensional vectors and processed with well defined algebraic operations. Despite this rich framework, most VSA systems rely on simple additive updates, where repeated observations reinforce existing information even when no new information is introduced. In non-stationary environments, this leads to the persistence of stale information after the underlying system changes. In this work, we introduce the Sequential Relevance Memory Unit (SRMU), a domain- and cleanup-agnostic update rule for VSA-based SAMs. The SRMU combines temporal decay with a relevance gating mechanism. Unlike prior approaches that solely rely on cleanup, the SRMU regulates memory formation by filtering redundant, conflicting, and stale information before storage. We evaluate the SRMU on streaming state-tracking tasks that isolate non-uniform sampling and non-stationary temporal dynamics. Our results show that the SRMU increases memory similarity by $12.6\%$ and reduces cumulative memory magnitude by $53.5\%$. This shows that the SRMU produces more stable memory growth and stronger alignment with the ground-truth state.

title: Blinded Multi-Rater Comparative Evaluation of a Large Language Model and Clinician-Authored Responses in CGM-Informed Diabetes Counseling
summary: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) is central to diabetes care, but explaining CGM patterns clearly and empathetically remains time-intensive. Evidence for retrieval-grounded large language model (LLM) systems in CGM-informed counseling remains limited. To evaluate whether a retrieval-grounded LLM-based conversational agent (CA) could support patient understanding of CGM data and preparation for routine diabetes consultations. We developed a retrieval-grounded LLM-based CA for CGM interpretation and diabetes counseling support. The system generated plain-language responses while avoiding individualized therapeutic advice. Twelve CGM-informed cases were constructed from publicly available datasets. Between Oct 2025 and Feb 2026, 6 senior UK diabetes clinicians each reviewed 2 assigned cases and answered 24 questions. In a blinded multi-rater evaluation, each CA-generated and clinician-authored response was independently rated by 3 clinicians on 6 quality dimensions. Safety flags and perceived source labels were also recorded. Primary analyses used linear mixed-effects models. A total of 288 unique responses (144 CA and 144 clinician) generated 864 ratings. The CA received higher quality scores than clinician responses (mean 4.37 vs 3.58), with an estimated mean difference of 0.782 points (95% CI 0.692-0.872; P<.001). The largest differences were for empathy (1.062, 95% CI 0.948-1.177) and actionability (0.992, 95% CI 0.877-1.106). Safety flag distributions were similar, with major concerns rare in both groups (3/432, 0.7% each). Retrieval-grounded LLM systems may have value as adjunct tools for CGM review, patient education, and preconsultation preparation. However, these findings do not support autonomous therapeutic decision-making or unsupervised real-world use.

title: Combinatorial Contracts Through Demand Types
summary:
In the combinatorial action model of contract design, a principal delegates a complex project to an agent, incentivizing a subset of actions from a ground set of $n$ actions, via a linear contract. Computing the optimal contract is a challenging problem that generally hinges on two factors: (i) the number of "critical values" - values of the linear contract parameter at which the agent's best response changes from one set to another, and (ii) the complexity of the agent's best-response problem (demand query). Prior work has used this approach to devise polynomial-time algorithms for the optimal contract problem under specific reward functions: gross substitutes, supermodular, and ultra.
  We develop a unified geometric framework for algorithmic contract design by establishing a fundamental link to the theory of demand types from consumer theory. Under this geometric view, bounding the number of critical values reduces to counting the best-response regions which the "contract ray" pierces. Leveraging this connection, we introduce the class of All Substitutes and Complements (ASC) functions, and show that it admits at most $O(n^2)$ critical values, strictly generalizing and unifying all previously known classes admitting poly-many critical values. We conjecture that, under some mild assumptions, ASC is the maximal such class. Turning to the demand query aspect, we develop a new technique for efficiently computing a demand query using value queries, which works in general for "succinct" demand types. Combining these structural and algorithmic results, we obtain polynomial-time algorithms for new classes of reward functions that exhibit substitutes and complements simultaneously.

title: MCSC-Bench: Multimodal Context-to-Script Creation for Realistic Video Production
summary: Real-world video creation often involves a complex reasoning workflow of selecting relevant shots from noisy materials, planning missing shots for narrative completeness, and organizing them into coherent storylines. However, existing benchmarks focus on isolated sub-tasks and lack support for evaluating this full process. To address this gap, we propose Multimodal Context-to-Script Creation (MCSC), a new task that transforms noisy multimodal inputs and user instructions into structured, executable video scripts. We further introduce MCSC-Bench, the first large-scale MCSC dataset, comprising 11K+ well-annotated videos. Each sample includes: (1) redundant multimodal materials and user instructions; (2) a coherent, production-ready script containing material-based shots, newly planned shots (with shooting instructions), and shot-aligned voiceovers. MCSC-Bench supports comprehensive evaluation across material selection, narrative planning, and conditioned script generation, and includes both in-domain and out-of-domain test sets. Experiments show that current multimodal LLMs struggle with structure-aware reasoning under long contexts, highlighting the challenges posed by our benchmark. Models trained on MCSC-Bench achieve SOTA performance, with an 8B model surpassing Gemini-2.5-Pro, and generalize to out-of-domain scenarios. Downstream video generation guided by the generated scripts further validates the practical value of MCSC. Datasets are available at: https://github.com/huanran-hu/MCSC.

title: SCENIC: Stream Computation-Enhanced SmartNIC
summary: Although modern, AI-centric datacenters heavily rely on SmartNICs, existing devices impose a hard trade-off. Commercial SmartNICs provide high bandwidth and easy software integration, but offer limited support for customization and data processing offload. In contrast, research SmartNICs often suffer from low bandwidth, limited functionality, and poor software compatibility -- to the point that many are not actual NICs in a technical sense. This gap can be closed by treating the NIC datapath as a first-class stream computation substrate with shared hardware/software abstractions for a tight co-design of infrastructure and applications. To demonstrate this, we introduce SCENIC, an open-source datacenter SmartNIC. SCENIC implements a 200G network datapath over offloaded TCP/IP and RDMA stacks, as well as a fallback path for processing arbitrary network traffic. On top of the network logic, SCENIC combines on-datapath Stream Compute Units (SCUs) for data processing and embedded ARM cores for flexible control path manipulation with direct access to GPUs and SSDs. SCENIC is fully integrated with the OS, exposing native Linux network and RDMA verb interfaces, making the programmable datapath transparent to existing applications while enabling control of, e.g., user-defined offloads and programmable congestion control. SCENIC's performance matches commercial platforms, and we show its versatility through several use cases such as offloaded collective communication and network-to-GPU hash-based data partitioning.

title: How to Correctly Make Mistakes: A Framework for Constructing and Benchmarking Mistake Aware Egocentric Procedural Videos
summary: Reliable procedural monitoring in video requires exposure to naturally occurring human errors and the recoveries that follow. In egocentric recordings, mistakes are often partially occluded by hands and revealed through subtle object state changes, while existing procedural datasets provide limited and inconsistent mistake and correction traces. We present PIE-V (Psychologically Inspired Error injection for Videos), a framework for constructing and benchmarking mistake-aware egocentric procedural videos by augmenting clean keystep procedures with controlled, human-plausible deviations. PIE-V combines a psychology-informed error planner conditioned on procedure phase and semantic step load, a correction planner that models recovery behavior, an LLM writer that performs cascade-consistent rewrites, and an LLM judge that validates procedural coherence and repairs failures. For video segment edits, PIE-V synthesizes replacement clips with text-guided video generation and stitches them into the episode to preserve visual plausibility. Applied to 17 tasks and 50 Ego-Exo4D scenarios, PIE-V injects 102 mistakes and generates 27 recovery corrections. For benchmarking, we introduce a unified taxonomy and a human rubric with nine metrics that cover step-level and procedure-level quality, including plausibility, procedure logic with annotator confidence, state change coherence, and grounding between text and video. Using this protocol, we audit several existing resources and compare PIE-V against a freeform LLM generation baseline under the same criteria. Together, the framework and rubric support post-completion verification for egocentric procedural mistake detection and correction.
